title: The Samurai Who Challenged a Leaf
brief: 10s 9:16 Samurai comedy with 2-bone bent-knee gait, katana contact, leaf reaction & deadpan payoff.
premise: A proud autumn samurai challenges a drifting maple leaf to a duel and loses effortlessly.
hook: A red maple leaf slaps right across Ren's gaze, triggering an over-dramatic samurai showdown.
